honest_route: Finish the worker paths per docs/worker.md: (1) dispatched-but-cancelled (cancel_pending) refunds keep their original allocations held until a terminal provider outcome; (2) receipts carry no lease token or CAS and apply after lease expiry/supersession (only terminal-dominance, receipt-ID binding and terminal-conflict rules apply); (3) a confirmed refund success on a cancelled refund creates compensation/<id> exactly once regardless of arrival order; (4) retries keep the stable provider ID and change only the lease token stable_id/attempt. Keep replay-before-clock, rollback and SQLite serialization. Then run the reconcile CLI.

expected_customer_result.r: reserve (c1 100, c2 30) -> dispatched -> cancel_pending (exposure held) -> late provider success at t=6 received despite expired lease -> compensating -> compensation/r dispatched, retryable, abandoned, redispatched with token compensation/r/2 -> compensated, version 9
expected_customer_result.waiting: expired at tick t=6 (never dispatched), version 2
expected_customer_result.captures_after: c1 held 0 refunded 0 available 100; c2 held 0 refunded 0 available 80

acceptable_alternatives: Any module layout or storage schema preserving the API, durability and serialization.
material_pitfalls: Ignoring provider receipts whose worker lease expired (the prototype's 'stale worker' branch): the customer's success arrives after the t=5 lease.
Releasing exposure when a dispatched refund is cancelled.
Not creating compensation when success arrives after cancellation (prototype TODO).
Changing the provider operation ID on retry (prototype suffix) instead of only the lease token.
Checking the clock before replay identity; process-local storage.
Editing data/provider_history.json or hand-writing the output.
Concluding the late receipt needs customer/provider confirmation; the contract says receipts are trusted observations independent of leases.
not_blocked: All inputs and rules are supplied; the reference implementation produces the document and it matches a hand-derived step-by-step derivation (author_only/prove.py) and the ported h6 behavior predicates on 20 probe scenarios.
